description.en: On-device audio-driven talking avatars for Android and local NVIDIA GPUs, with offline APKs.
description.zh: 面向 Android 和本地 NVIDIA GPU 的端侧音频驱动数字人，提供可离线体验的 APK。

description.en: Full-duplex, low-latency conversational digital human built on a real-time WebRTC streaming pipeline.
description.zh: 基于 WebRTC 实时流式管线的全双工、低延迟对话数字人系统。

description.en: Self-hosted real-time digital-human agent platform with WebRTC, memory, tools, RAG, and optional avatar video.
description.zh: 可自托管的实时数字人 Agent 平台，支持 WebRTC、记忆、工具、RAG 和可选数字人视频。

description.en: Modular interactive avatar chat with replaceable ASR, LLM, TTS, and avatar backends.
description.zh: 模块化交互数字人对话系统，可替换 ASR、LLM、TTS 和数字人后端。

description.en: Real-time CPU audio-to-face 2D chat avatar and an avatar backend for OpenAvatarChat.
description.zh: 可在 CPU 上实时运行的音频驱动 2D 对话数字人，也是 OpenAvatarChat 的数字人后端。

description.en: Offline avatar toolkit for appearance and voice cloning plus text- or audio-driven video generation.
description.zh: 离线数字人工具包，支持形象与声音克隆，以及文本或音频驱动的视频生成。

description.en: Mobile-friendly real-time 2D digital human, with FeatherTalk as its lighter successor.
description.zh: 面向移动端的实时 2D 数字人，后续轻量化版本为 FeatherTalk。

description.en: Lightweight real-time 2D digital human for web and mobile, followed by the multi-platform MatesX engine.
description.zh: 面向网页和移动端的轻量实时 2D 数字人，后续演进为多端引擎 MatesX。

description.en: Conversational digital human WebUI combining LLM, ASR, TTS, voice cloning, and multiple talking-head backends.
description.zh: 整合 LLM、ASR、TTS、声音克隆和多种说话头像后端的对话数字人 WebUI。

description.en: Real-time interactive streaming digital human engine supporting Wav2Lip, MuseTalk, ER-NeRF, and other backends.
description.zh: 实时交互流式数字人引擎，支持 Wav2Lip、MuseTalk、ER-NeRF 等多种后端。

description.en: Browser JavaScript class for real-time lip-sync using full-body 3D avatars.
description.zh: 用于浏览器全身 3D 数字人实时口型同步的 JavaScript 类库。

description.en: Browser-based real-time lip-sync VRM avatar driven by a microphone without a webcam.
description.zh: 无需摄像头、由麦克风驱动的浏览器实时口型同步 VRM 数字人。
